skill.name: fatigue-frequency-manager
skill.description: Use when the user asks whether paid ads are fatiguing, why CTR or CVR is dropping at scale, or whether to rotate creative, widen audience, or hold. It reads frequency, CTR, CVR, reach, and baseline trends from user-provided exports. It does not build replacement creative or score the ROAS gate.

remediation.suggestion: Document that ad-set identifiers must be passed as data through a quoted argument or argument array, and never by copying untrusted labels into a shell command.

content.user_title: Diagnose Ad Fatigue Before Scaling Breaks
content.value_statement: Scaled campaigns can waste spend when frequency rises and CTR or CVR decays. This skill turns exported paid media trends into rotate, widen, or hold decisions with clear thresholds.
actual_capabilities: Compares current frequency against an early-flight baseline.
Reads CTR and CVR decay slopes from daily or weekly exports.
Separates creative fatigue from audience saturation using reach and frequency behavior.
Flags conversion tracking risk before acting on CVR drops.
Returns one rotate, widen, or hold trigger per ad set.
limitations: It needs a time series export; a single-day snapshot is not enough.
It does not create replacement ads or landing page copy.
It does not compute the full ROAS quality score or apply vetoes.
Direct ad platform API access is optional and not required.

use_cases.title: Check scaling fatigue
use_cases.description: A paid media manager reviews rising frequency and falling CTR before increasing budget.

use_cases.title: Choose the next action
use_cases.description: A growth marketer decides whether to rotate creative, widen the audience, or hold current delivery.

use_cases.title: Prepare client reporting
use_cases.description: An agency strategist summarizes fatigue signals, thresholds, caveats, and next-skill handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Quick fatigue check
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of one ad set.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this ad set export for fatigue. Tell me whether to rotate creative, widen the audience, or hold, and explain the threshold that fired.

prompt_templates.title: Baseline comparison
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare current performance with the early stable window.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the first stable post-learning window as the baseline. Compare current frequency, CTR, CVR, and reach, then diagnose creative fatigue versus audience saturation.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-ad-set triage
prompt_templates.scenario: Prioritize decisions across several active ad sets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Read these ad set trend exports. Return one trigger per ad set, rank the most urgent fatigue risks, and list any missing data that changes confidence.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced measurement check
prompt_templates.scenario: Validate whether a CVR drop is real before acting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this fatigue read against GA4 or ecommerce conversion truth. Flag tracking risk, double counting risk, and any reason the CVR trend should not drive a scaling action.

output_examples.input: Prospecting Set A shows frequency rising from 1.7 to 5.8 while CTR falls 42 percent and reach still grows.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: likely creative fatigue. Trigger: rotate creative. The reach pool is still expanding, so the main issue is repeated exposure to tired creative, not audience exhaustion.

output_examples.input: Retargeting Set B shows flat reach, frequency above the stated ceiling, falling CTR, and falling CVR.
output_examples.output: Diagnosis: likely audience saturation. Trigger: widen audience or refresh the retargeting pool. Verify conversion tracking before treating the CVR drop as a true demand signal.

output_examples.input: Ad Set C has only yesterday's dashboard snapshot and no learning-exit date.
output_examples.output: Decision: stop and ask for a time series export or the learning-exit date. A fatigue slope cannot be read from one daily snapshot.

best_practices: Use the first stable post-learning window as the baseline.
Label each metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Confirm CVR movement against order truth before acting on it.
anti_patterns: Calling fatigue from one daily snapshot.
Using a universal frequency ceiling for every objective.
Rotating creative when broken conversion tracking explains the drop.

faq.question: What data does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a daily or weekly export with frequency, reach, CTR, CVR, spend, and the baseline window.

faq.question: Can it work without CVR data?
faq.answer: Yes. It can read a CTR and frequency fatigue signal, but it will mark CVR as unavailable.

faq.question: Does it build new ads?
faq.answer: No. It diagnoses the trigger and hands creative production to an ad creative skill.

faq.question: Does it replace a full paid account audit?
faq.answer: No. It flags fatigue and measurement risk, but it does not score the full ROAS gate.

faq.question: How does it separate fatigue from saturation?
faq.answer: Creative fatigue usually shows CTR decay while reach still grows. Saturation usually shows reach plateauing while frequency climbs.

faq.question: Is direct platform access required?
faq.answer: No. Manual exports are enough. API connectors are optional convenience tools.
